DEVICE DESCRIPTION
The 3B Flex-Lite"M is a mask interface, of the nasal pillow variety, that directs airflow from a
positive pressure device to the patient's nose. The mask is held in place with adjustable
headgear that straps the mask to the face.
The 3B Flex-Lite'"M is safe when used under the conditions and purposes intended as indicated in
the labeling provided with the product.
The 3B Flex-Lite m is a prescription device supplied non-sterile.
INTENDED USE
The 38 Flex-LiteTM channels airflow noninvasively to a patient from a positive airway pressure
(PAP) device such as a continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) or a bilevel system. The 38
Flex-LiteTM is:
(1) to be used by adult patients (>661b / 30 kg);
(2) to be used for single-patient reuse in the home environment and multipatient
reuse in the hospital/institutional environment.
(3) to be used in the following environments: home, hospital, and sub-acute
institutions.
(4) intended for prescription use.
CONTRAINDICATIONS: None
TECHNOLOGICAL CHARACTERISTICS COMPARISON
The 38 Flex-Lite'" is differentiated from the predicate devices based primarily on differences in
form, fit and comfort. The headgear is constructed out of Breath-O-PreneM fabric, a laminated
knit textile which serves as the loop for a Velcro fastener. Breath-O-Prene TM is a popular fabric
for the CPAP headgear market used in the predicate devise Swift FX, and is also currently being
used in similar applications by several other manufacturers, including Phillips Respironics GoLife
Nasal Mask K110008) , Fisher & Paylkel (Opus Nasal Mask K063036) and Resmed (Ultra Mirage
Nasal Mask K(050359).
000008
3B-M 3B Flex-Lite Nasal Mask (K 103434)
The nasal mask itself incorporates four vent holes to provide continuous air leak to flush out
and minimize the amount of C02 rebreathed by the patient. The design of the mask
components is such that the incorporation of these vent-holes does not interfere with the
intended performance of the mask.
The 38 Flex-Lite'" nasal mask is very similar to the predicate Innolved Nasal Aire-Il mask. Both
are cannula style mask systems with similar performance characteristics. Performance bench
testing of both the 38 Flex-Lite Tm and the Nasal Aire I1 were conducted. These tests demonstrate
substantial equivalence of the proposed device with the predicate device. Copies of test reports
are included in Appendiix A.
The 3B Flex-Lite TM is similar to the predicate Resmed Swift FX inasmuch as they have similar air
seal systems (i.e. nasal pillow design) and utilize the same headgear fabric (i.e. Breath-O-
Prene T M ). A summary of the comparisons of the proposed device and the predicate devises is

Non-clinical Tests
Testing of the 3B Flex-Lite TM was compared to the predicate InnoMed Nasal Aire 11 for
performance and safety. Performance testing of both the proposed device, the 38 Flex-Lite'",
and the Nasal-Aire 11 predicate device was performed by Piper Medical. A copy of the test
report dated March 23, 2011 is annexed at Appendix A.
In terms of design, both the Nasal-Aire 11 and the proposed device are cannula style nasal
interfaces, with the air flow supplied to the interface from lateral sides..The performance bench
testing consisted of three sets of testing: passive exhalation port flow (App. A at p. 6),
resistance to flow (App. A at p. 8), C02 re-breathing percentage (App. at p. 9), and
measurement of dead space (App. A at p. 9). Based on the results of these tests, the report
finds that the 38 Flex-Lite'" is "substantially equivalent to the Nasal-Aire 11 in terms of
performance"
Substantial Equivalence Conclusion:
3B Flex-Lite m is substantially equivalent to the predicate devices. it has the same intended use.
It has similar technological characteristics to both predicates. It does not raise new questions of
safety and effectiveness. And, it is at least as safe and effective as the predicate devices Nasal-
Aire 11 and Swift FX.
